source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
A unit that a rule removes from the battlefield and puts into **strategic reserves** during the battle is a **repositioned** unit. Besides that rule's own terms, such as where it may arrive, all of these apply:

- In the Movement phase, the rule can pick a unit that already moved that phase.
- If it is set up again in the same turn it Advanced, Fell Back or made a **Disembark move**, that move still counts.
- Effects with a set duration or set conditions keep applying to it off the battlefield for as long as they last.

Repositioned units are exempt from the end-of-battle-round-3 destruction in [Arriving From Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/arriving-from-strategic-reserves) (20.03).

otherRulesStillApply.including: when such units can and cannot arrive

rules.effects: for a specified duration or specified circumstances

detail.arrivalTiming: set by the repositioning rule; 20.02 names no battle round
